lines.en: label yumispring4:
scene skycold
Spring is different from how it’s supposed to be here.
lines.zh: 这里的春天跟它该有的样子不一样。

lines.en: Well, I guess it’s not really supposed to be here at all if you really want to get technical about it.
lines.zh: 好吧，你要是真想较真的话，它本来就不该出现在这里。

lines.en: But it is. And sometimes, it’s hotter. Sometimes, it’s colder. There’s never any rhyme or reason, though.
lines.zh: 可它确实在。而且有时候更热，有时候更冷。从来没什么道理可讲。

lines.en: We seldom even check our phones for the weather forecast anymore since there was only a 25%% chance it’d be correct on any given day.
lines.zh: 我们现在连手机上的天气预报都懒得看了，因为不管哪一天，它准确的概率都只有 25%。

lines.en: Life at this point is just a sequence of waking up, looking out the window, then opening the front door to try and confirm our suspicions.
lines.zh: 到了这个地步，生活就是一串动作：醒来、往窗外看一眼、然后打开前门去验证自己的猜测。

lines.en: I thought I had it right today. The sun was shining, the flowers were basking in its light, and I envisioned a world in which this blazer alone would feel like too much.
lines.zh: 我以为今天我猜对了。阳光明媚，花儿沐浴在光里，我还想象了一个只穿这件西装外套都嫌多的世界。

lines.en: And I was right at first. But now I’m wrong.
lines.zh: 一开始我是对的。可现在我错了。

lines.en: Now, it’s cold. And while there is no snow to serve as a more physical, tangible reminder of this, there’s still the creeping nostalgia and silence that always comes falling to earth alongside it.
lines.zh: 现在，冷了。虽然没有雪能更具体、更实在地提醒我这一点，但那份随之而来的、悄悄爬上心头的怀旧与寂静，还是照旧落到了地面上。

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold1
That silence is quickly broken by ska music, though.
lines.zh: 不过，这份寂静很快被 ska 音乐打破了。

lines.en: : Wow. I can’t even remember the last time I heard this song.
lines.zh: : 哇。我都记不清上一次听到这首歌是什么时候了。

lines.en: : And I can’t remember the last time you said anything that made any amount of sense.
lines.zh: : 我也记不清上一次你说过什么稍微有点道理的话是什么时候了。

lines.en: : You look really pretty today, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你今天真漂亮，Yumi。

lines.en: : Die.
lines.zh: : 去死。

lines.en: : How glad I am that some things never change.
lines.zh: : 有些事永远不会变，我真高兴。

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold2
: The fuck are you even doing here? We stopped runnin’ into each other like this fucking {i}years{/i} ago, didn’t we?
lines.zh: : 你他妈的来这儿干什么？我们{i}好几年{/i}前就不再这么偶遇了吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. Because now we have each other’s phone numbers and can hang out whenever we want.
lines.zh: : 是啊。因为现在我们有彼此的电话号码，想什么时候见面都行。

lines.en: : Soooo...never?
lines.zh: : 所以呢……永远不见？

lines.en: : Never. Every day. Same difference.
lines.zh: : 永远不见。每天都见。反正都一样。

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold3
: I repeat — die.
lines.zh: : 我再重复一遍——去死。

lines.en: : We’ve come a long way, haven’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们走了很远了，不是吗？

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold4
: Hm?
: Just that you only hate me out of habit, now. We’ve been through too much together for any of that to be authentic at this point.
lines.zh: : 只是觉得，你现在恨我纯粹是出于习惯。我们一起经历了太多，到这一步，那种恨已经不可能是真的了。

lines.en: : I have plenty of reasons to hate you still. I barely even have a best friend anymore now that she thinks I’m fucking you.
lines.zh: : 我恨你的理由多得是。现在我连个最好的朋友都快没了，因为她以为我在跟你上床。

lines.en: : Actually, current Chika would {i}allow{/i} you to fuck me so long as it's under the pretense that we love one another.
lines.zh: : 其实吧，现在的 Chika 是{i}允许{/i}你跟我上床的，前提是打着我们彼此相爱的旗号。

lines.en: : Yeah. Which brings me back to the whole “I barely even have a best friend anymore” shit because your fucking creepy relationship with her somehow rotted her brain and turned her into a sex zombie.
lines.zh: : 是啊。这就又绕回「我连个最好的朋友都快没了」那件事了，因为你跟她那变态的关系不知怎么把她脑子搞坏了，把她变成了性僵尸。

lines.en: : Oh, I see what you mean now.
lines.zh: : 哦，我明白你的意思了。

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold5
: Guess you’re right about going through a lot together, though. Don’t feel the need to run away anymore, at least.
lines.zh: : 不过你说我们一起经历了很多，大概是对的。至少我现在不觉得有必要逃跑了。

lines.en: : Yeah. I imagine knowing the world could end at any moment sort of overtakes me in the threatening department.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我想，知道世界随时可能完蛋这件事，在「威胁感」这一项上已经把我盖过去了。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold6
: What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 你来这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Looking for you, I guess.
lines.zh: : 找你吧，大概。

lines.en: : Why? We settin’ up another apocalypse meeting or something?
lines.zh: : 为什么？又要开一场末日会议什么的？

lines.en: : No. Just wanted to see you and wishfully thought we might fatefully bump into one another up here again.
lines.zh: : 不是。只是想见你，而且一厢情愿地想着，说不定能在这上面宿命般地撞见你。

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold7
: Mm. We sure have a lot of {i}fated{/i} meetings on top of shit, don’t we?
lines.zh: : 嗯。我们在这堆破烂顶上的{i}宿命{/i}相遇可真够多的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Think it means something?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这意味着什么？

lines.en: : That we’re...always lookin’ down on everyone else, maybe?
lines.zh: : 意味着我们……总是在俯视别人？大概？

lines.en: : Oh, cool. I didn’t expect you to actually have an answer. Guess Imani’s been teaching you well if you’ve figured out symbolism now.
lines.zh: : 哦，不错。我没想到你还真有答案。看来 Imani 教得不错，你现在都懂象征了。

lines.en: : She’s...fine.
lines.zh: : 她……还行。

lines.en: : Still...
lines.zh: : 不过还是……

lines.en: : Kind of wish it was you, though.
lines.zh: : 有点希望是你就好了。

lines.en: : Uh...did my ears just deceive me? Or did you just-
lines.zh: : 呃……我的耳朵骗了我吗？还是你刚刚——

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold8
: D-Don’t get the wrong idea! There’s just...more pressure on me now! I ain’t allowed to fuck up as much as I could when you were the teacher!
lines.zh: : 别、别误会！只是……现在我的压力更大了！你是老师的时候，我犯错的余地可比现在大多了！

lines.en: : What?! Don’t just...stare at me, fuckmonkey! Say something!
lines.zh: : 什么？！别光……盯着我啊，蠢猴子！说话啊！

lines.en: : I’m glad I met you, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴遇见了你，Yumi。

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold9
: {i}What?{/i}
: Man, you ain’t gonna fuckin’ try to kill yourself again, are you? Because I got major death flags from that.
lines.zh: : 老兄，你该不会又打算去自杀吧？因为我从这话里闻到了浓烈的死亡 flag。

lines.en: : No, nothing like that. It’s just comforting knowing there’s someone else along for the ride who isn’t going to just forget how long it’s been anymore.
lines.zh: : 不，不是那种。只是知道还有另一个人陪着走这一遭，而且这个人不会再忘记这一切有多久了，这让我安心。

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold10
: We don’t...know that for sure, though...
lines.zh: : 可我们……也不确定啊……

lines.en: : Blondie says there’s a chance my shit might get reset again even {i}if{/i} I made it through the last...thing.
lines.zh: : Blondie 说，{i}就算{/i}我熬过了上次那件事，我的记忆也有可能再被重置一次。

lines.en: : There’s a chance for that to happen to any of us.
lines.zh: : 这种事发生在我们任何人身上都有可能。

lines.en: : Then ain’t it a little dangerous to start talkin’ about how nice it is to have somethin’ that could be taken away at any moment?
lines.zh: : 那现在开始说「拥有随时可能被夺走的东西真好」这种话，不就有点危险了吗？

lines.en: : Ain’t that gonna just...make it hurt even more if it actually happens?
lines.zh: : 那不是只会……在真发生的时候更疼吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...I know that better than anyone. At least...{i}now{/i} I know that better than anyone. Someone else held that honor until recently.
lines.zh: : 是啊……这一点我比谁都清楚。至少……{i}现在{/i}我比谁都清楚。不久之前，这份「荣誉」还属于另一个人。

lines.en: : Ponytail...right?
lines.zh: : 马尾辫那个……对吧？

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold11
: So {i}she’s{/i} the one you-
lines.zh: : 所以{i}她{/i}就是你——

lines.en: : {i}Was{/i} the one.
lines.zh: : 曾经{i}是{/i}。

lines.en: : I don’t know what I want anymore. Or who. Or...even {i}when.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己想要什么了。也不知道想要谁。甚至……不知道是{i}什么时候{/i}。

lines.en: : When?
lines.zh: : 什么时候？

lines.en: scene continuingrestart25
scene yumibridgecold11
: I just...feel like there’s more to this sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我只是……有时候觉得这背后还有更多东西。

lines.en: : More...how?
lines.zh: : 更多……什么？

lines.en: : It’s hard to explain. But...
lines.zh: : 很难解释。但是……

lines.en: : What if this is only one example of Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 万一这里只是 Kumon-mi 的一个样本呢？

lines.en: : I ain’t followin’...
lines.zh: : 我没听懂……

lines.en: : Well, you said yourself that you had memories of things that hadn’t actually happened to you before, right?
lines.zh: : 你自己说过，你有关于一些根本没发生过的事的记忆，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, but...ain’t that shit just from different timelines or whatever?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可……那不就是什么不同时间线之类的东西吗？

lines.en: : Maybe. But different timelines are essentially different worlds, aren’t they? Like...what if there’s a world out there where you and I are talking up here right now while holding hands?
lines.zh: : 也许。但不同的时间线本质上就是不同的世界，不是吗？比如……万一在某个世界里，你和我现在正牵着手在这儿说话呢？

lines.en: : Then I’m perfectly fine with stayin’ exactly where or {i}when{/i} I am.
lines.zh: : 那我对我现在所处的这个{i}时空{/i}就满意得不得了。

lines.en: : Yumi-
lines.zh: : Yumi——

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold12
: I get what you’re sayin.
lines.zh: : 我懂你的意思。

lines.en: : It all just sounds too fuckin’ convenient, though. And it ain’t like we have any way of actually {i}gettin’{/i} to those worlds or...timelines or...whatever the fuck you wanna call ‘em.
lines.zh: : 只是这一切听起来都太他妈的凑巧了。而且我们又没有任何办法真的{i}去到{/i}那些世界、那些时间线、或者随便你他妈的怎么叫它们。

lines.en: : So imaginin’ the possibility of something like that ain’t gonna do shit but make you feel even more helpless than you already are.
lines.zh: : 所以去想象那种可能性，除了让你比现在更觉得自己无能为力之外，什么用都没有。

lines.en: : If you {i}could{/i} go anywhere...at any time...where would you go?
lines.zh: : 如果你{i}能{/i}去任何地方……在任何时间……你会去哪儿？

lines.en: : Feel like we had a similar talk before...
lines.zh: : 感觉我们以前聊过类似的话题……

lines.en: : Well...I imagine we probably did then. But my memory’s shit even {i}without{/i} the interference of time and the divine. So why not just give me {i}current{/i} Yumi’s answer?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我猜我们大概真的聊过。可就算{i}没有{/i}时间和神明的干扰，我的记性也烂得要命。所以不如就给我一个「{i}现在的 Yumi{/i}」的答案吧？

lines.en: : Current Yumi...
lines.zh: : 现在的 Yumi……

lines.en: : Current Yumi would probably stay right here.
lines.zh: : 现在的 Yumi 大概会就待在这儿。

lines.en: : There is no way {i}this{/i} is the happiest you can be.
lines.zh: : 你不可能{i}这{/i}样就最幸福了。

lines.en: : Yeah. Well current Yumi ain’t about to start fantasizing about worlds where everything goes well for her when she ain’t done shit to deserve it.
lines.zh: : 是啊。可是现在的 Yumi 还没做出什么值得的事，她不会开始幻想那种一切都顺顺利利的世界。

lines.en: : Yumi, you’re not-
lines.zh: : Yumi，你不是——

lines.en: : Can you spare me whatever bullshit you’ve got to say about how I’m not {i}that{/i} bad just because I ain’t as shitty as I used to be? I’m still a fucking bitch. And {i}you’re{/i} still a fucking predator.
lines.zh: : 你能不能省省那套「你没{i}那么{/i}坏」的废话，就因为我没以前那么烂了？我还是个婊子。{i}你{/i}也还是个捕食者。

lines.en: : We can’t redeem ourselves for that. We’ve gotta...start over. Build ourselves up from the bottom. But neither of us have it in ourselves to actually do that, so...
lines.zh: : 我们没法为那些事赎罪。我们得……从头开始。从最底下把自己重新建起来。可我们俩都没那个本事真的做到，所以……

lines.en: : Current Yumi would stay right where she is...and accept whatever punishment {i}time and the divine{/i} have in store for her. The other Yumis can benefit from making better choices than her.
lines.zh: : 现在的 Yumi 会待在原地……接受{i}时间和神明{/i}为她准备的惩罚。别的 Yumi 可以从她身上吸取教训，做出更好的选择。

lines.en: : You’ve really grown up, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你真的长大了，Yumi。

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold13
: Rad. Maybe you’ll finally leave me alone now.
lines.zh: : 酷毙了。那你现在总该离我远点了吧。

lines.en: : Doubtful. I’m bound to fatefully encounter you in higher altitudes for the rest of our lives. It’s just how things work here, I think.
lines.zh: : 很难说。我这辈子注定要在高海拔的地方宿命般地撞见你。我觉得这儿就是这么运作的。

lines.en: : Well, for what it’s worth...
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管怎么说……

lines.en: : I’m glad I met you too.
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴遇见了你。

lines.en: : Want to pick up where we left off on the beach and actually kiss now?
lines.zh: : 要不要从海滩那次接着来，现在真的亲一下？

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold14
: And risk Chika showin’ up and {i}actually{/i} tossing me over a railing this time? Pass.
lines.zh: : 然后赌 Chika 会不会突然出现、这次{i}真{/i}把我从栏杆上扔下去？免了。

lines.en: : We could always go somewhere more pri-
lines.zh: : 我们也可以去个更私——

lines.en: : Don’t.
: Just don’t...okay?
lines.zh: : 就是别……好吗？

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold15
: I’ve already conceded that I don’t hate you. Just take that as a win for now and stop pushing me to do more. I’ve got enough going on in my head as-is.
lines.zh: : 我已经让步承认我不恨你了。你就先当这是场胜利，别再逼我做更多了。我脑子里的事已经够多了。

lines.en: : If I ever want to {i}enable{/i} you, I’ll make the first move.
lines.zh: : 要是我哪天真想{i}成全{/i}你，我会先主动的。

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold16
: Still ain’t ever gonna happen, though. Not unless {i}time{/i} magically throws us into a world where we’re the same age.
lines.zh: : 不过这事儿永远不会发生。除非{i}时间{/i}神奇地把我们扔进一个我们同岁的世界。

lines.en: : So you’re saying you’d be with me if we were the same age?
lines.zh: : 所以你是说，如果我们同岁，你就会跟我在一起？

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold17
: I’m saying you’d have a much better shot.
lines.zh: : 我是说你的胜算会大很多。

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold18
: That is {i}all{/i} I’m going to say, though...pervert.
lines.zh: : 不过我就说{i}这么多{/i}……变态。

lines.en: scene skycold
: I’ll take it. It’s better than knowing I have no chance at all.
lines.zh: : 我接受。总比知道我一点机会都没有要好。

lines.en: : Yeah. Meanwhile, I’ll continue wanting to throw up in my mouth for just knowing you {i}want{/i} one.
lines.zh: : 是啊。与此同时，光是知道你有那个念头，我就{i}想{/i}吐在自己嘴里。

lines.en: : Yeah...my life would be so much easier if everyone else looked at things like you.
lines.zh: : 是啊……要是别人都像你这么看问题，我的人生会轻松多了。

lines.en: : Hah. You think having {i}more{/i} of me around would make your life easier? Only reason I haven’t kicked the shit out of you yet’s because you’re bigger than me.
lines.zh: : 哈。你觉得身边{i}多几个{/i}我，你的人生就会轻松？我到现在还没把你打得满地找牙，纯粹是因为你比我块头大。

lines.en: : Nineteen other Yumi’s, though? You’re fucked.
lines.zh: : 不过要是十九个别的 Yumi？你就完蛋了。

lines.en: : So many Yumis. It’s like a dream come true.
lines.zh: : 好多 Yumi。简直像美梦成真。

lines.en: : A nightmare, more like.
lines.zh: : 更像是噩梦吧。

lines.en: scene black
: Do you have any plans after this?
lines.zh: : 之后你有什么安排吗？

lines.en: : After what? Convincing you to fuck off and leave me alone so I can go back to spitting on cars?
lines.zh: : 在什么之后？在说服你滚蛋、别烦我、好让我继续去吐口水砸车之后？

lines.en: : Yeah. I don’t have any plans for tonight. So I was wondering if maybe-
lines.zh: : 对。我今晚没什么安排。所以我在想，也许——

lines.en: : Pass.
lines.zh: : 免了。

lines.en: : Tch. One day, you’ll appreciate me for who and what I am.
lines.zh: : 啧。总有一天，你会因为我是谁、我是什么而欣赏我的。

lines.en: : Heh. Maybe.
lines.zh: : 嘿。也许吧。

lines.en: : I’ve already got plans tonight, though. And...lookin’ at the time, I should probably start headin’ over now.
lines.zh: : 不过我今晚已经有安排了。而且……看看时间，我大概该动身了。

lines.en: : Heading over {i}where{/i} exactly? Should I be worried? Is it a {i}boy?{/i}
lines.zh: : 动身去{i}哪儿{/i}？我该担心吗？是个{i}男的{/i}？

lines.en: : It’s my mom, you fucking douchenozzle.
lines.zh: : 是我妈，你这个蠢货。

lines.en: : You’re leaving me for your mom? What kind of soap opera is this?
lines.zh: : 你要为了你妈丢下我？这是什么狗血连续剧？

lines.en: : You want to come too? Just gonna watch movies and shit.
lines.zh: : 你也想来？就是看看电影什么的。

lines.en: : You’re actually inviting me?
lines.zh: : 你真的在邀请我？

lines.en: : So long as you don’t say yes. I have to uninvite you if you agree.
lines.zh: : 只要你别说好。你要是答应，我就得收回邀请。

lines.en: : Why even give me a choice then?
lines.zh: : 那你干嘛还给我选择？

lines.en: : Sometimes, you’ve {i}gotta{/i} give somebody a choice. Even if the answer’s already made up. It’s the only way to make ‘em think they’re really free.
lines.zh: : 有时候，你{i}得{/i}给别人一个选择。哪怕答案早就定好了。这是让他们以为自己真的自由的唯一办法。

lines.en: : None of us are free here. No choice will convince me otherwise.
lines.zh: : 这里没有一个人是自由的。任何选择都说服不了我。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...we can’t all be as smart as you.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那又怎样……我们又不可能都像你那么聪明。

lines.en: : Later, Sensei. I’ll see you when I see you.
lines.zh: : 回头见，Sensei。该见的时候自然会见。

lines.en: : Probably on another bridge or something...
lines.zh: : 大概又是在哪座桥上之类的……

lines.en: Yumi turns to leave, but I decide to stay up here for a little while longer.
lines.zh: Yumi 转身离开，但我决定在这上面再多待一会儿。

lines.en: I don’t plan on spitting on cars or anything like that, though — just passing time while I wait for the world to catch up to how fast I’ve been spinning lately.
lines.zh: 不过我可不打算去吐口水砸车什么的——只是打发时间，等这个世界追上我最近旋转的速度。

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold19
As the world continues to spin, a single ant attempts to stop it.
lines.zh: 就在世界继续旋转的时候，一只蚂蚁试图让它停下来。

lines.en: The ant’s name is Yumi Yamaguchi — and she will soon learn just how weak she is even {i}if{/i} she can lift things up to fifty times her body weight.
lines.zh: 这只蚂蚁叫 Yumi Yamaguchi——而她很快就会明白，{i}就算{/i}她能举起比自己体重重五十倍的东西，她有多么弱小。

lines.en: : Oh! Yumi!
lines.zh: : 哦！Yumi！

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold20
: Hm?

{size=-3}Another cool ant fact is that the queen of the Pogonomyrmex occidentalis owyheei is the second longest living insect with a lifespan of up to 30 years. This is only 20 years less than the maximum lifespan of a termite queen.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-3}另一个很酷的蚂蚁冷知识是：Pogonomyrmex occidentalis owyheei 的蚁后是寿命第二长的昆虫，最长可活 30 年。这仅仅比白蚁蚁后的最长寿命少 20 年。{/size}

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold21
: Coming to see your mom? Would you mind giving her this? Mailman left her shit in my box again.
lines.zh: : 来看你妈？能帮我把这个交给她吗？邮差又把她的东西塞进我的信箱了。

lines.en: : Why do you know my name?
lines.zh: : 你为什么知道我的名字？

lines.en: : Because you’re my new best friend’s daughter, obviously.
lines.zh: : 因为你显然是我新交的好闺蜜的女儿啊。

lines.en: : Who even are you?
lines.zh: : 你到底是谁啊？

lines.en: : Not the mailman, that’s for sure! So please relieve me of needing to hold onto this as I will not be able to resist the temptation of opening it and I can’t handle another felony. I just can’t.
lines.zh: : 反正不是邮差！所以求你接过去吧，不然我实在抵不住拆开它的诱惑，我可不能再背一条重罪了。真的扛不住。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine, yeah. Give it here. Probably just a bill or something.
lines.zh: : 行吧，行。给我。大概就是账单什么的。

lines.en: : Woo! Thanks. Love you. Tell your mom I said hi.
lines.zh: : 哇！谢啦。爱你。替我跟你妈问好。

lines.en: : Uh...no?
lines.zh: : 呃……才不？

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold22
Did you know that ants don’t have ears? They listen by feeling vibrations in the ground. And they communicate with other ants by using their body to produce pheromones.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，蚂蚁没有耳朵。它们靠感受地面的震动来「听」。它们还用身体分泌信息素来跟其他蚂蚁交流。

lines.en: : Yuki! You home? Your fucking weirdo neighbor gave me your mail.
lines.zh: : Yuki！你在家吗？你那个怪胎邻居把你的信给我了。

lines.en: A group of ants is called a “formicary.” They are social creatures who, like bees, distribute and delegate different responsibilities to everyone in the colony.
lines.zh: 一群蚂蚁被称为「蚁群(formicary)」。它们是社会性生物，像蜜蜂一样，会把不同的职责分配、委派给群体里的每一个成员。

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold23
: Let’s see how much you fuckin’ owe. Maybe I can help out now that I’ve actually got a job?
lines.zh: : 让我看看你他妈欠了多少钱。也许我现在有工作了，能帮上点忙？

lines.en: Ants are found on every single continent except for Antarctica. And one species, the trap jaw ant, can close its jaws at a speed of 140mph! How crazy is that?
lines.zh: 除了南极洲，每一个大洲都有蚂蚁。而其中一种——大齿猛蚁(trap jaw ant)，合拢双颚的速度能达到每小时 140 英里！是不是很疯狂？

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold24
Do you know the craziest part of all, though?
lines.zh: 不过，你知道最疯狂的部分是什么吗？

lines.en: scene yumibridgecold25
We’re just like them when you really start to think about it.
lines.zh: 当你真的开始想，就会发现我们跟它们一模一样。

lines.en: scene black
We’re all so small in the grand scheme of things — running around in circles and trying to fulfill some sort of arbitrary purpose we come up with that won’t ever {i}really{/i} matter.
lines.zh: 在宏大的图景里，我们都那么渺小——绕着圈子跑，试图完成某个我们自己编出来的、其实永远不会{i}真正{/i}重要的目标。

lines.en: But we’ll tell ourselves it does because we need a meaning to live. We need a meaning to run around in circles from dusk ‘til dawn.
lines.zh: 但我们会告诉自己它重要，因为我们需要一个活下去的意义。我们需要一个从日出到日落不停绕圈的意义。

lines.en: But if you take one ant away, will anyone really notice?
lines.zh: 可如果你把一只蚂蚁拿走，真的会有人注意到吗？

lines.en: If you’re the queen, sure.
lines.zh: 如果你是蚁后，当然会。

lines.en: If you’re anyone else, though?
lines.zh: 可如果你是别的任何一只呢？

lines.en: How long will it take the others to even notice you’re even gone?
lines.zh: 要过多久，其他的才会发现你不见了？
